entities.summary: Lysøya is an uninhabited island in Bjørnafjorden Municipality in Vestland county, Norway. The 0.72-square-kilometre (180-acre) island lies in the Lysefjorden, a small branch off the main Bjørnafjorden. The island name was historically spelled Lysøen.
